method: Affine entry-relative SP dataflow proves every normal return restores SP and every reachable write remains within the sum of all constant decrement sites. Loops reach a fixed point or refuse. Sum all sites per function plus the largest child; indirect calls include every fixed-table target. Positive-allocation SCCs refuse.
premises: LLVM disassembler correctly decodes the byte-verified instruction spans and operands.
Host imports do not synchronously re-enter positive-stack functions. The Grid host's storage-capacity callback uses only the separately verified zero-stack constant inbox-capacity getter.
This bounds one normal-entry invocation from the initialized SP, followed by normal restored returns. It does not authorize resuming an instance after an arbitrary trap left its SP unrestored.
This bounds the linear-memory ABI stack, not the Wasm engine's separate execution stack or arbitrary invalid pointer writes.
Imported memory is not concurrently mutated; fixed internal function table is neither imported, exported nor mutated.
